 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 27 October 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Take the high road, Taurus . Not every tiny thing that draws your attention deserves a thesis on it. Choose to remember what it feels like to go with the flow, surrender to what the cosmos is bringing your way and take each day as it comes. A lot is shifting within you right now, but this is also a time when you need to take extra care of yourself and the world you are nurturing. Dish out truths and communicate your expectations in the kindest possible way. You have been working towards something and there is a lot you have already planned, executed or begun inching towards. Leo , today may feel like a mixed bag, with a lot of what you planned playing out while other things leave you doused in anxiety and worry. Protect your peace like it is the only thing that matters, Cancer . There may be a lot of opinions, particularly unwanted ones, being hurled your way and perhaps you may even be at a point where karmic retribution is at play. So, even if you find yourself at the receiving end of some nonsense, play your cards with mental balance and poise, not because you deserve it but because you don’t deserve to lose your peace of mind over things that won’t even matter a week later.
 Read on for what the stars have in store for you and make sure you check out your sun, moon and rising signs for the complete picture.
 Aries Horoscope Today: October 27, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Instead of overthinking and wallowing in self-pity, Aries , you have risen to the occasion and decided to take matters into your own hands. Choose your options wisely and safeguard your interests as you excitedly gear up for what lies ahead. You know you have made choices that don’t exactly make you belong to the village you once knew. But you must also remember that you are here to create something new and the last thing that should influence you is your fear. If you fall, you will rise; if you fumble, you will find the right words again; if you are confused, you will take a deep breath and clear the mental fog. Don’t let your current circumstances decide what your future will hold for you.
 Cosmic tip: Seek tangible, practical security but remember not to hold on too tightly.
 Taurus Horoscope Today: October 27, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Take the high road, Taurus . Not every tiny thing that draws your attention deserves a thesis on it. Choose to remember what it feels like to go with the flow, surrender to what the cosmos is bringing your way and take each day as it comes. A lot is shifting within you right now, but this is also a time when you need to take extra care of yourself and the world you are nurturing. Dish out truths and communicate your expectations in the kindest possible way. Find your emotional anchor and keep reinforcing it through whatever makes you feel stable and secure. This is not the time to get petty or lose yourself in chaos. This is the time to set your own frequency for whatever it is you are pursuing.
 Cosmic tip: Trust your intuition, lead with your heart and keep your ears open.
 Gemini Horoscope Today: October 27, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You only wished for a happily ever after, Gemini . All you wanted was for life to feel happy and full once again. Yet here you are, walking through this Venus and Saturn retrograde with a broken heart and tired legs. However, things are about to speed up soon, so take this upcoming opportunity for space with open hands. Take time for yourself and get to know yourself better. Understand and accept what you truly want from your life, relationships, goals and even yourself, even if it is a far cry from what you thought you wanted a year ago, if not longer. Momentum will arrive only when you give it direction.
 Cosmic tip: Strike when the iron is hot. Until then, take the time you need to think about what you are creating.
 Cancer Horoscope Today: October 27, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Protect your peace like it is the only thing that matters, Cancer . There may be a lot of opinions, particularly unwanted ones, being hurled your way and perhaps you may even be at a point where karmic retribution is at play. So, even if you find yourself at the receiving end of some nonsense, play your cards with mental balance and poise, not because you deserve it but because you don’t deserve to lose your peace of mind over things that won’t even matter a week later. Remember that Saturn is retrograding alongside Venus and Mercury, shifting the focus to relationships, patterns and old ways resurfacing. The more you stay grounded in yourself and take a calm stand on whatever truly matters, without the drama and emotional outbursts, the more brownie points you earn from Saturn. And Saturn loves to reward determined and focused action.
 Cosmic tip: Think before you react. Not everything is worth the emotional cost it incurs.
 Leo Horoscope Today: October 27, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You have been working towards something and there is a lot you have already planned, executed or begun inching towards. Leo , today may feel like a mixed bag, with a lot of what you planned playing out while other things leave you doused in anxiety and worry. The details may feel excruciatingly painful, but you know what? You are onto something. And that is enough motivation to keep you going.
 Cosmic tip: Leave that old version of yourself and your plan behind. Approach things with a fresh mindset and excitement.
 Virgo Horoscope Today: October 27, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You let the world think and feel what it wants. You left the village behind, never to return, yet that doesn’t change the fact that you know where you belong. Virgo , life may be coming full circle and you may find yourself in a place where certain things require you to take a stand. This time, however, you do it calmly and with poise. Somehow, you know that the cosmos is behind you and has your back. All you need to do is show up for what and who you love with all your heart.
 Cosmic tip: Let your heart lead while your mind plans and puts things into action.
 Libra Horoscope Today: October 27, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) A fresh start of sorts has you feeling supported and encouraged. Libra , something in your life has got you looking forward to things once again and you are willing to disentangle yourself from the multiple layers of responsibility and the unnecessary weight of other people’s expectations and false obligations. You suddenly feel as though the weight of the world has been lifted from your shoulders and now you are ready to take on the world.
 Cosmic tip: Keep doing what you are doing. You are headed in the right direction.
 Scorpio Horoscope Today: October 27, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Family, community, teamwork, collaboration and the feeling of simply belonging to your tribe have been on your mind. Scorpio , you may be feeling as though you have been thrown into a flashback of sorts. You may feel nostalgic for the little things while also feeling torn between worlds. This is the time to take a break, rest your swords and accept that even the bravest warriors need downtime every now and then.
 Cosmic tip: Let your mind rest. Ask the cosmos for support and help.
 Sagittarius Horoscope Today: October 27, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Some adjustments are needed from you right now. Sag , we know you love things your way, but you must also remember that finding peace and quiet through inner calm and poise takes effort. It is, however, worth far more than simply going to war at the drop of a hat. Your current phase in life does not require you to fight every fight. It requires you to know which battles are worth picking.
 Cosmic tip: Sometimes bending helps you live to fight another day.
 Capricorn Horoscope Today: October 27, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) The balancing act you have been navigating is ushering in a new era and a new chapter. Cap , you have worked hard all your life and, no matter what anyone else thinks, you know things have not come easily to you. Today’s message is not about a single day. It is about the end of an era, a phase in which you kept feeling as though you bore the brunt of everything and were probably not appreciated as much as you deserved. This is what is shifting. You are becoming more discerning and are being encouraged to receive without hesitation or guilt.
 Cosmic tip: Keep doing the inner and outer work. The cosmos is gearing up for a huge breakthrough and a blessing in your favour.
 Aquarius Horoscope Today: October 27, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) A fork in the road. You are not exactly happy with what you have been given, but you also know that what has passed cannot be retrieved in its original form. Aquarius , you have been praying for your own pretty little landscaped garden and you must remember that it is about to arrive. Not by fluke but through the conscious, consistent effort you have been putting in over time. This moment of confusion, as valid as it may seem, might not have the crippling effect it is having on you. Use your signature superpower to zoom out and think outside the box. You’ve got this.
 Cosmic tip: Looking at things purely through the mind may not provide answers. Look through the heart and let your gut guide your logic.
 Pisces Horoscope Today: October 27, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Your mind may have been in overdrive, Pisces . You may find yourself feeling overly emotional about certain things, but you may also realise that some things are better approached with a clear mind and your long-term goals in mind. You want more meaning in life and it is here for you. But you must use all this retrograde energy to fuel your way forward by choosing to reflect carefully, revisit old decisions and weigh your options wisely. You have what it takes; you only need to remember that.
 Cosmic tip: Light your fire, fan it well and keep the flame focused on your goals.
